_note: The eight fighters of DESIGN.md for the side-view platform fighter. Positions are stage pixels (480x270), y up from the feet for hitboxes: a box move hits a w x h box whose centre is x ahead and y above the feet. kb + growth x damage% / 100 is the launch speed (before weight and toughness); angle is the launch direction in degrees (0 ahead, 90 up, negative down). Frames are 1/60 s. Each fighter has four specials like Super Smash Flash: `specials.neutral`, `.side`, `.down`, and up + special is `recovery`. Olentzero has `unlock`. All numbers are tunable starting values (BALANCE.md). `tune` balances fighters against each other: `dealt` scales the damage and knockback they deal, `taken` the knockback they take (set by tools/balance_rr.mjs from computer round robins).
